text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Pearl-senpai! We're having a party 
soon, and of course you're coming, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"By the way, what kind of party is this? 
Shall I dance? Hey, danciiing♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, I'm fine. It's just a cooking 
party, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sounds lovely. What kind of food do 
they have?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Right, french fries, nuggets... Maybe some 
rice balls and miso soup wouldn't hurt 
either!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Miso soup is truly... tasty. That flavor 
that cannot be replaced by anything—ah, my 
heart is racing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I saaaid!! You don't need to 
dance!!
